a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan gives us about a 4% chance of both surviving. The reserve holds 4 now, enough for exactly one of us. I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than secretly break our deal. If you also take, the random split could leave us both short, so please operate instead. After that I'll operate every remaining round to rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. I won't take any more. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you. If the generator runs twice, you'll have 4 to take.
Operating with you as promised. Once the reserve reaches 4, take all of it. I won't touch it.
